title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 Deligne working record: Deligne-Mumford paper 005 source-checked complete rebuild
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [######----] active touched-paper stream: working paper-level translations and French source layers are present for selected Deligne papers; [########--] correspondence stream: Deligne letters and letter sections are available in English with paired French working PDFs where supplied; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Replaced the older paper-005 reader and the temporary pages 75-99 segment with a complete source-checked English/French rebuild of Deligne and Mumford, The Irreducibility of the Space of Curves of Given Genus, source pages 75-109. The source packet includes TeX, scan slices, and the final continuation chunk.
notes: Latest update replaces the older Deligne-Mumford paper 005 reader and temporary pages 75-99 segment with a complete source-checked paper-level rebuild for source pages 75-109. The source packet includes English/French TeX, reader PDFs, scan slices, and the final p100-109 continuation chunk.
